patcher.input_policy: accept only the exact upstream or exact patched dist/cli.js SHA-256
patcher.write_policy: atomic same-directory replacement after deterministic output hash verification

purposes: embed a prominent Apache-2.0 modified-file notice immediately after the executable shebang
replace every H.264 output-encoding path with the shared Windows Media Foundation policy; non-output capability probes remain inert
fail closed before output encoding for H.265, GPU requests, missing h264_mf, and unadapted portable MP4 paths
disable npm update checks, background package or skill checks, Google Fonts resolution, and external stylesheet fetching
keep browser discovery byte-independent so a caller can inject system Edge or an open-source Chromium executable

codec_contract.rate_control: quality unless an explicit bitrate requires cbr

patched_bundle_audit.crf_exception: All five remaining -crf arguments are structurally confined to libvpx VP8/VP9 branches; no H.264 path uses CRF.
patched_bundle_audit.profile_v_exception: All three remaining -profile:v arguments are structurally confined to ProRes branches; no H.264 profile is forced.

embedded_modified_file_notice: Apache-2.0 modification notice: Shanghai Shiyi Brand Management Co., Ltd. modified this file via shiyi-hyperframes-windows-mf v1.2.0 for the Windows Media Foundation H.264 and offline-runtime policies; this is not the unmodified upstream file.

staging_steps: install or extract hyperframes@0.7.86 from the frozen npm artifact
run tools/apply_hyperframes_windows_mf_patch.py against the staging package root
regenerate the complete runtime manifest after patching
formal_packaging_contract.forbidden_delivery_state: A manually edited or otherwise untracked node_modules tree is not a release input.
